key_concepts: separate floating, fixed, and Perform Mode windows
Window Operator source panel or node viewer
common_gotchas: Window COMP is active; DocsBrain can misclassify it as deprecated because the hardware frame-lock parameter is deprecated.
For final output, prefer one large Perform Window over many separate windows unless the design explicitly needs popups or test windows.
Hardware frame-lock use in Window COMP is deprecated; Direct Display Out TOP is the recommended path for frame-lock workflows.
On macOS, spanning all monitors requires the system Displays Have Separate Spaces option to be off.
DPI scaling changes addressable resolution; use Monitors DAT to inspect display scale before setting exact pixel sizes.
The Window Placement Dialog controls startup display behavior, so opening a Window COMP once is not the same as making it the default Perform Window.
Info CHOP exposes window position, size, open state, fill, and border diagnostics for live checks.
build_relevance: 2025.30000+ Perform Mode and multi-display window placement
